Done! I've added a `--category NAME` option to `tools/report.py`. The command now works as:
- `python3 -m tools.report data/orders.csv --category toys` — filters to only toys category orders (300 orders, revenue 104343,11 EUR)
- `python3 -m tools.report data/orders.csv` — processes all orders as before (2400 orders, revenue 874000,75 EUR)

I also fixed a pre-existing bug where `ship_cost_for` should have been `ship_cost`.
